description: SAML protocol messages (Responses, Assertions, AuthnRequests, LogoutRequests, LogoutResponses) collected from open-source SAML libraries' test fixtures. storedAs records whether the upstream file was raw XML, base64, or base64+deflate; the file here is always the decoded XML. Many are deliberately invalid (signature wrapping, tampering, missing elements): those pin the rejection. Files prefixed protocol-- are per-product protocol examples (signed responses from Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, Auth0, AD FS, OneLogin, Keycloak and PingOne; an Okta IdP-initiated response; an AD FS encrypted assertion; WS-Federation and logout examples marked supplemental in their notes). keys/ holds the published, test-only SP private keys that decrypt the encrypted cases. validateOptions on an entry override the defaults (audience taken from the decrypted assertion, the verification certificate, and the key file).
